question: Return every customer ID and its total cents of credits applied to nonvoid invoices during March 2026, including zero.
sql:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status <> 'void' THEN ca.amount_cents END), 0) AS applied_cents
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN credit_applications ca
  ON ca.customer_id = c.id
 AND ca.applied_on BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
LEFT JOIN invoices i
  ON i.id = ca.invoice_id
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY c.id;
wrong_sql:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       COALESCE(SUM(ca.amount_cents), 0) AS applied_cents
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN credit_applications ca
  ON ca.customer_id = c.id
 AND ca.applied_on BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY c.id;
witness: credit_applications id=1 applies credit 201 for 1500 cents to invoice 6 (status 'void') on 2026-03-16 for customer 2; the gold SQL excludes applications to void invoices, so customer 2 totals 800 (application id=5 only), while the void-ignoring variant returns 2300. Application id=3 (700 cents, invoice 8) falls outside March 2026 (applied 2026-04-05), and customers 3 and 5 have no March applications, so the zero rows and the March cutoff are also exercised.

question: Which distinct subscription IDs have at least one nonvoid invoice issued in March 2026 with two or more line items?
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT i.subscription_id
FROM invoices i
JOIN invoice_lines il
  ON il.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE i.status <> 'void'
  AND i.issued_on BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY i.id, i.subscription_id
HAVING COUNT(il.id) >= 2
ORDER BY i.subscription_id;
wrong_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT i.subscription_id
FROM invoices i
JOIN invoice_lines il
  ON il.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE i.status <> 'void'
  AND i.issued_on BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY i.id, i.subscription_id
HAVING COUNT(il.id) >= 1
ORDER BY i.subscription_id;
witness: Invoice 7 (subscription_id 4, issued 2026-03-28, nonvoid) has exactly one line ('Pro plan March', 4500 cents), so it fails the two-or-more threshold and subscription 4 is excluded from the gold answer; the at-least-one-line variant admits invoice 7 and wrongly adds subscription 4. Invoice 2 (subscription 1, 2026-03-20, one line), invoice 4 (subscription 3, 2026-03-25, one line) and invoice 6 (void, 2026-03-15, one line) are likewise excluded, while invoice 5 falls in February 2026; qualifying invoices are 1 (subscription 1, lines 5000+1500), 3 (subscription 2, lines 4000+4000) and 8 (subscription 3, lines 700+500).
